sweeps: The runtime docs (/Users/k/p/symbiotic/submodules/runtime/docs) are the deepest, most contract-rich spec set in the ecosystem. The memory canon is genuinely memory-centric and converges hard with the memory-strategy thesis: vault-as-truth.md + unified-ingest-memory-architecture.md define an event-sourced substrate (L0a Capture Log / L0b Derivation Journal → L1 chunks → L2 Markdown Ledger → L3 throwaway SQLite index) with one write seam (ContentFetcher), one read door (Recall Gateway ContextRequest→ContextPack), append-only + supersede-by-append discipline, blocking CI recreatability gates, and dreaming (Flow H) as a closed read→L0b→reproject loop. Most of it is verified implemented (I checked trust lattice, derivation.write scope, write_back, embedder pin in code). The weaknesses: (1) the newest canon (L0a/L0b, Ledger, dreaming, Memory Kit) is absent from NAMING-CANON, and 'Vault' and 'Archive' are each 3-way overloaded; (2) a parallel #152 benchmark-lever doc cluster (15 docs, unindexed) duplicates exactly the levers symbiotic-mem-bench owns (rerank pool/keep, count diversity, current-state evidence, provenance deref); (3) real side-channels of truth exist despite the doctrine — daemon bridge/observability JSONL stores, ManagementStore work items/leases, FSRS/edge-weight/somatic/tool-memory 'earned' state living only in the deletable L3 index, and Matrix as the authoritative thread transcript; (4) the entity-ledger file format here and the OKF format in the standalone symbiotic-memory repo are two competing candidates for the 'published L0 format' the strategy doc wants. The sibling docs (build-on-memory-plan, interaction-model) do not exist yet.

Swept the symbiotic parent-repo working layer completely: CONTEXT.md/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, docs/{architecture(1 live app doc), design(4 docs + 9 prototypes), analysis(1), audits(2026-04-23 four-wave tree), security(3), research(5), reviews(6 Feb-2026 historical), reports(~35 + INDEX)}, knowledge-base/, tasks/ (160+ folders + ledger). This layer is the PROCESS + DECISION + AUDIT truth of the ecosystem; the tech canon lives in submodules/runtime/docs (a separate domain it constantly points into). Its crown jewels: (a) CONTEXT.md's operating canon including the Tier-0 contract-freeze surface list — the only cross-repo catalog of breaking-change API surfaces; (b) the reports-INDEX governance model with a SIGNED GO-conditional launch decision and RATIFIED redaction-only egress waiver; (c) the June memory audit trilogy (vault-implementation → completeness → perfection), the most accurate living map of the memory system anywhere: reactive memory (capture→distill→archive→recall) audited wired-live with a CI-blocking byte-equal recreatability gate, while the autonomous half dead-ends — dream findings stop at L0b, agent traces live in recall-invisible side stores, the production agent recall door bypasses the gateway, human edits are un-journaled, DreamReports are logged-and-dropped. Against the memory-centric invariant this domain both documents the substrate's strongest guarantee and ruthlessly catalogs its side-channels — and is itself one: the tasks/NEXT.md ledger agents are required to persist into never round-trips to the Archive. Biggest doc-level defects: the L0 format spec the 2026-07 strategy depends on does not exist; the four loop-closer gaps are specified only inside reports under pseudo task-numbers that collide with real ledger ids; naming drift is live (Open/Private/Sealed vs Shareable/Private/Restricted, Self/Methodology AND Identity/Operations directories both on disk, 4-vs-7 distillery stages); and the promised build-on-memory-plan / interaction-model sibling docs are absent. Date staleness is well-managed for reports (INDEX tiers) but unmanaged for research/ (Jan–Feb docs still recommending retired tech) and for CONTEXT.md's memory paradigm text, which predates the membench measurements.

symbiotic-memory's docs (SPEC/DESIGN/IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC/RUNBOOK/DEFAULT-RUNTIME-PROFILE) define a coherent three-layer substrate — Archive Markdown+YAML as durable truth, SQLite as rebuildable operational ledger, vector/keyword indexes as rebuildable recall satellites — with strong anti-pattern discipline (no regex routing, no synthetic evidence, exactly two prompt surfaces). Code verification shows the write half is real (OKF frontmatter writer, MemoryStore, zvec hybrid RecallIndexBackend, stage manifests, lifecycle enums, slot_key supersession) but the read-back half is aspirational: there is NO OKF parser or Markdown re-index path, so SQLite plus staged-fact JSON is the de facto source of truth; the Recall Gateway sensitivity contract exists only as a filter struct that the recall engine never invokes and that no writer ever populates (sensitivity is always None). Doc-vs-code drift is significant (MemoryStore grew 5 undocumented collapse-to-source methods; RecallPolicy has ~8 undocumented fields; planner has a third undocumented Compact mode; DEFAULT-RUNTIME-PROFILE contradicts code on pool shape). The 2026-07 strategy thesis's L0 'publish the format' move is cheap because the format exists in code — but the memory-centric invariant currently fails in both directions: the Archive is write-only (never recalled from) and recall never writes back (no audit/answer events, no human-edit-as-supersede).

symbiotic-foundation (/Users/k/p/symbiotic-foundation) is a 4-crate, ~5.1k-line contract-first workspace: symbiotic-core (148-line identifier/sensitivity vocabulary), symbiotic-queue (durable SQLite work queue with leases/idempotency/DLQ/cooldowns), symbiotic-trace (ModelInvocationTrace + pluggable sinks), symbiotic-model (provider traits, queue-bound wrappers with retry/rate-limit/cache, per-model queue-config catalog, OpenAI-compatible + Gemini adapters). Docs (README, ARCHITECTURE.md, MIGRATION.md, TRACE-SINKS.md) are honest about status and match the code closely, with two real contradictions (ProviderCatalog hard-codes sensitivity policy the docs assign to hosts; the queue-config catalog carries benchmark-tuned per-model knobs despite the 'no benchmark-specific code' non-goal). Real consumers today: symbiotic-memory (git dep; QueuedChat/Embedding wrappers + default_model_queue_config + SqliteQueue + TraceSink), symbiotic-mem-bench (core+queue only, path-patched via .cargo/config.toml, LongMemEval row work items on SqliteQueue), smartoffice/crates/execution (path dep; OpenAiCompatibleChatProvider + QueuedChatProvider + SqliteQueue for classifiers). The legacy symbiotic runtime does NOT consume it (Phase 4 bridge unstarted) and still owns colliding crate names. Measured against the memory-centric invariant, the crate that exists to be 'the central learning tap' (symbiotic-trace) never round-trips to the Archive: the promised ArchiveTraceSink/UsageMeterSink/AuditSink family is spec-only, traces drain to JSONL side files, and the model layer holds three genuine side-channels of truth (plaintext response cache without sensitivity gating, process-global rate/cooldown statics, hash-only queue payloads that make 'durable' work unreplayable).

smartoffice/docs specifies a complete vertical "Company OS" built around a Memory Plane that is, structurally, a second independently-evolved memory substrate: an Obsidian-compatible Markdown+YAML vault as sole truth, rebuildable derived indexes, git-as-history, RBAC + in-flight redaction at the recall boundary, hash-chained HMAC audit, and a provenance-preserving ingest pipeline (SourceReceipt → IngestEnvelope → review case → module dispatch). The convergence with symbiotic-memory is real and deep (md+YAML truth, satellites-rebuildable, trust-at-recall, raw-vs-derived separation) but there is ZERO shared contract: the entity frontmatter dialect, lifecycle vocabulary, provenance model, and recall interface are all parallel inventions. The docs are internally strong on the storage/security architecture (planes, tiers, derived-index contract, audit chain) and internally weak on exactly the things symbiotic-memory has already solved or measured (vector recall, distillation, re-embedding, eval refereeing) — those appear as 'Phase 2' hand-waves. Biggest memory-centric defects: human Obsidian edits bypass MemoryMutation entirely (no events, no audit, no supersede — the substrate's own human surface writes around the gateway), git history is a side-channel of 'why' that never round-trips into recallable memory, and vault/journal/ is explicitly excluded from the entity/relationship graph. The two promised sibling symbiotic docs (build-on-memory-plan, interaction-model) do not exist yet; audit proceeded without them.

The referee domain (mem-bench-2/docs/spec 00-07 + demo-brief + hermes strategy/requirements notes) is a spec-first, three-layer design system (spec → lo-fi → hi-fi) for an (adapter × benchmark)-agnostic memory-benchmark cockpit with four persona workspaces. Its load-bearing contracts are the StepEnvelope append-only trace ledger, the two manifests (AdapterCapabilityManifest / BenchmarkManifest) resolved into a per-pair context, provenance-stamped materialized views, and the 06 data-contract dictionary that maps every screen's Data: line to a mock type today and a protobuf product tomorrow. Verification against code confirms the spec's own honesty flags: the ledger, manifests, and view provenance exist only as proto sketches in docs/redesign/05 — the shipped wire format is still the stringly-typed membench.dashboard.v1 debugger.proto (*_json blobs), the mock models a flat StepEvent, and the promised docs/delivery data-api contract (pass 5) does not exist yet. Against the memory-centric invariant, the cockpit reads the substrate exactly once (R7 vault-backed store snapshot, read-only) and otherwise accumulates earned truth — verdicts, hard-set census, judge-suspect flags, human bad-gold corrections — in bench-private stores that never round-trip to the Archive; the audit/ReviewState channel is the clearest defect, since it is precisely the human-edit-as-supersede primitive the strategy note names as the ecosystem's one missing piece.
